note: Actual first-party text and selected color plates downloaded and viewed21Oct2026. Publication copyright1893; LoC metadata says unaware of any copyright restrictions. Plate colors are depicted1893 catalog colors, not proven pigment values.
rights_note: 1893 United States publication; original copyright expired. IA metadata of LoC copy states: The Library of Congress is unaware of any copyright restrictions for this item. Institutional scans and selected plate/text hashes are retained in the21Oct evidence packet.
